title: Nakit Akışı
_comment: Synthetic cash-flow tab shaped like the real incident: row 1 empty, header on row 2 with an empty first cell (the date column has no name), ragged rows, and a balance column (Bakiye) right before the income column (Gelir). Dates are offsets from the real today ({"days": N}) because the model is told the real date. Cells: null = empty, {"text", "value"} = a number displayed Turkish style.
